legend.0: No empirical support beyond random: every relevant model fails corrected testing and results match random controls.
legend.1: Weak or fragile apparent support: small uncorrected differences, unstable across periods or settings.
legend.2: Some repeatable out-of-sample support, but no corrected confirmation and substantial uncertainty.
legend.3: Corrected confirmation-period support that is stable across sensitivity settings.
legend.4: Strong support replicated across independent models, periods and prospective outcomes.

legend.0: Poor: tickets largely duplicate each other.
legend.1: Limited: substantial overlap in mains or repeated Super Balls.
legend.2: Moderate: some overlap; coverage clearly broader than one ticket.
legend.3: Good: low main overlap and distinct Super Balls.
legend.4: Maximal: no main overlap and three distinct Super Balls.
